title: Finite realization preserves the coefficient-unit adjunct

source.place: paragraph (1), applying coefficient extension to the positive section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its adjunction

statement: Fix a universe u, a condensed commutative coefficient ring R on Profinite at u with values in Ab at u+1, a commutative ring A of type Type(u+1), and a scheme Y at u. Set P=ProjectiveLine Y. Let eY,eP be FiniteRealization data on Y,P, and D,D-prime specified derived direct images for P to Y and s their FinitePushSquare [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization]. Suppose hc identifies D-prime.R with the canonical ordinary finite pushforward and hcanonical identifies its universal derived unit. Then eY.derived(coefficientUnitPush R Y D), followed by the supplied derived square, hc and the direct image of eP.derivedUnit, equals eY.derivedUnit followed by the canonical derived adjunct of geoP1UnitPullback [def-diagonal-coefficient-unit-push, sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology]. No positive line, Chern arrow or trace is involved.

proof.text: The underlying ordinary push-square equation fixes the direct image comparison. FiniteRealization.unit_normalization uses unital coefficient-ring isomorphisms, so this comparison sends the ordinary coefficient-unit adjunct to the ordinary constant-unit adjunct. Evaluate the full derived-unit square on the regular module and cancel the single comparisons using singlePushComparison_square. The canonical-unit equation identifies the remaining supplied universal unit with the canonical derived one, and the canonical derived adjunction unit formula identifies the result with the adjunct of geoP1UnitPullback.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_unit_push
    {R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}} [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (eY : FiniteRealization R A Y) (eP : FiniteRealization R A (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (D : DiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar R (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (D' : DiagonalRightDerived (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (hc : D'.R = geoP1Pushforward A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))
    (hcanonical : IsCanonicalRightDerived
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) D' hc)
    (s : FinitePushSquare R A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) eP eY D D') :
    let t := s.derived.iso.hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft eP.F.mapDerivedCategory (eqToIso hc).hom
    eY.F.mapDerivedCategory.map (coefficientUnitPush R Y D) ≫
        t.app (unit R (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≫
        (geoP1Pushforward A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map eP.derivedUnit =
      eY.derivedUnit ≫
        finiteUnitAdjunct A Y
